verdict.rationale: Benchmark documents a self-serve export of contacts and lists at any time, which covers the core of audience portability. Nothing shows that the export includes custom fields, tags, engagement history or the suppression list, or that it uses an open format. The API's contact search and campaign-results access are building blocks, not an audience export, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented export of custom fields, tags, per-contact engagement history and suppression list; a stated open file format (e.g. CSV); independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can export my entire audience — contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, and suppression list — in an open format, self-serve

citations.quote: Export your contacts and lists at any time.
